A BEE NEST Can EXPOSE Your Base...
description:
A bee nest remembers where its bees found flowers — and that location stays
inside the item when you mine it with Silk Touch.

So if someone hands you a nest they collected at their base, the flower
coordinates come with it.

This actually happened. On the Minecraft server Constantiam, a clan called
ZERO — led by a player named _Spw_ — posted trades on Discord asking for bees
in exchange for valuable items, then used the coordinates to find and destroy
the bases they came from. It ran from March 3rd to May 12th, 2023, until a
server plugin patched it. Mojang never did.

Sources:
Constantiam Wiki — "Beehive Coordinate Exploit"
https://constantiam.miraheze.org/wiki/Beehive_Coordinate_Exploit

Technical writeup by epicfacethe3rd
